text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in opening paragraph","quality":"argument focus","description":"The essay states a direct position early and keeps the whole response centered on defending that view."},{"evidence":"benefits first, drawbacks then rebuttal","quality":"organization","description":"The essay uses a recognizable argumentative structure that presents opposing points and then answers them."},{"evidence":"“For example… Additionally… Lastly… All in all…”","quality":"cohesion","description":"The essay uses transitions to connect ideas and move the reader through the argument more smoothly."},{"evidence":"multiple article details such as fuel use, liability, vibrating seats, flashing lights, entertainment systems","quality":"supporting evidence","description":"The essay draws on several specific details from the source to support its claims."},{"evidence":"“less stress with traffic jams,” “save money from having to pay for wrecks, insurance”","quality":"development of reasons","description":"The essay expands its reasons with explanation rather than only stating opinions."},{"evidence":"“should they really be a thing?” and “companies across the globe should work towards the creation of them”","quality":"persuasive tone","description":"The essay uses engaging language that sounds more intentionally argumentative and convincing."}]}
